attributes.title: Nurse Leader Institute 2027
attributes.venue: LSU Health Sciences Center Medical Education & Innovation Center
attributes.cme_provider: LSU Health New Orleans School of Nursing (P0111)
attributes.summary:
A week-long commitment with a lot of hours attached: 36.5 contact hours over January 25 to 29, 2027, in Baton Rouge, through the LSU Health New Orleans School of Nursing continuing development program (P0111).

It suits a nurse moving toward a first leadership role in acute, long-term, home, public health or academic settings. Talk to your manager early, because five days away takes planning. The fee is not published yet on this page.
